2) Locate Invoice Date:
- Found "Datum: 26.01.2024" near top. Candidate value: "26.01.2024".

3) Locate Sender VAT ID:
- Two VAT-like occurrences:
  a) Near top: "USt-Id:                   ATU22642807"
  b) Footer: "USt-IdNr. ATU14391601"
- Both are explicit VAT identifiers for the sender; cannot invent which is primary. The document lists both; primary prominent USt-Id appears near header (ATU22642807). Will select the header USt-Id as Sender.VatId (per no-inference: choosing explicitly present value).

4) Determine totals and VAT groups:
- Nettowert gesamt shown as "82,88" (EUR) — appears labeled "Nettowert gesamt 82,88".
- VAT line: "10% MWSt von 82,88 8,29" — indicates a 10% VAT rate applied to net 82,88 producing VAT amount 8,29.
- There is also a "00% MWSt von 0,00 0,00" line (zero-rate group) but it contributes nothing; primary VAT group is 10%.
- Bruttobetrag shown as "91,17" (EUR) — matches 82,88 + 8,29 = 91,17.

5) Map to schema fields (no guessing beyond visible values; keep decimal places):
- GrandTotal.Amount: Bruttobetrag = 91,17 -> numeric 91.17 (preserve two decimals).
- Invoice.Date: "26.01.2024" (string).
- Sender.VatId: "ATU22642807" (from header).
- Vat.Rate: 10 (extract rate without %).
- Net.Amount: 82,88 -> numeric 82.88.
- Vat.Amount: 8,29 -> numeric 8.29.

6) Verify no conflicts with rules:
- All extracted values are explicitly present; no inferred values used.
- Multiple VAT occurrences handled by selecting the explicit 10% group providing non-zero amounts; zero-rate group omitted since it has zero amounts and schema expects a single set (per available non-zero VAT).
- Decimal places preserved (two decimals).
